macro.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RealProjectivePlane.Proportional
macro.description: The proportionality relation on the nonzero triples of real numbers. Parameter/style contract: style `default` is the nullary relation symbol (the relation as a value, rendered `\sim`); style `applied` is the binary predicate of arity 2 (rendered `#0 \sim #1`). The relation is carried by the set of nonzero triples.
